title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Rich Lander
defect_history: Deep localized Apple lander with international banners, dense DOM, variable aperture specs, and high-resolution media. Previously tested for potential false-positive dead-page classification, layout timeouts, and screenshot viewport truncation defect (Playwright clip without full_page clamped screenshot to 1080px viewport instead of full document height). Must extract complete text, tall full-page screenshot (>= 10,000 px, <= 1 MB), and status 2.
